systems.system: Digital Liberia: Equity, Sovereignty, and Innovation for a Connected Future
systems.tiers: Described as the ministry's five-year strategic plan, designed to expand broadband, strengthen infrastructure and cybersecurity, modernise government services and create economic opportunities; the minister reported progress since its launch on 21 July 2026

systems.system: Executive Order No. 163 (Office of Technology, Digitization and Innovation)
systems.tiers: Signed 22 April 2026; OTDI within the Office of the President coordinates digital transformation under a unified technology strategy

note: The document calls Digital Liberia the ministry's own five-year plan and gives no adoption act, period, plan or report against targets, only a minister's claim of progress; classed as the document describes it, so no fact is recorded.
